offer.summary: 25 requests per day for most datasets
conditions: The free API key covers up to 25 requests per day for most datasets. Real-time and 15-minute delayed US stock data require a premium plan; commercial licensing varies by endpoint.

offer.summary: 5 credits per month
conditions: Free includes 5 concurrent browsers and up to 500 browser sessions. Completed tasks cost 0.1 credits each; other usage can have different costs.

offer.summary: $5 platform usage per month

Keyless MCP access is limited to Actor discovery and documentation tools; running Actors or accessing run data requires authentication and uses the account allowance.

offer.summary: 2,000 auth events and 2,000 tool calls per month

offer.summary: 5,000 API credits for a 7-day trial
conditions: No payment card required. This is trial access, not a confirmed renewable allowance.
Domain, proxy and JavaScript-rendering multipliers affect credit consumption.

offer.summary: 10,000 free API credits per month
conditions: No payment card required; failed requests consume no credits.
Successful requests have different costs for rendering, residential proxies and AI extraction; credits are not equal to a guaranteed number of pages.
The hosted MCP server uses the same API-credit balance; request settings determine the cost, so MCP calls are not a separate unlimited allowance. An account API key is required.

sources.purpose: official MCP setup and access requirements

offer.summary: 1,000 trial credits
conditions: No card required; the pricing page offers 1,000 starting API credits without promising monthly renewal or publishing their expiry.
Proxy and feature choices affect credit consumption. The official MCP requires an API key and consumes the same metered service credits.

sources.purpose: official MCP setup and credit consumption

offer.summary: 100 free credits; provider calls this a trial and monthly renewal is unclear
conditions: The pricing comparison labels Free as 100 monthly credits, but the signup FAQ calls the initial allowance a trial. Renewal and expiry are unconfirmed; no recurring monthly allowance is assumed.
No credit card required; one concurrent request. Failed requests are not charged. API features consume different credits, so the allowance is not 100 requests for every endpoint.

offer.summary: 100 screenshots per month
conditions: No card required; features and proxy usage may have additional costs.

offer.summary: 100 starting requests
conditions: No card required; 100 requests are offered at signup, with no recurring renewal or expiry stated on the reviewed page. Only successful searches are charged.

offer.summary: 250 searches per month
conditions: Free includes 250 searches per month, limited to 50 searches per hour. The reviewed pricing page does not specify a free-plan card requirement.

offer.summary: 2,500 starting queries
conditions: No card required. Do not treat signup allowance as recurring.

offer.summary: 10 starting credits valid for 30 days
conditions: No card required; staging and production environments are separate.

providers.name: Speechmatics
providers.description: Speech-to-text APIs for prerecorded files and live audio.

offer.summary: $100 starting transcription credits
conditions: No payment card required. This is starting credit, not a confirmed monthly free allowance.
Models, realtime processing and add-ons consume credit at different rates. Free realtime access is limited to 2 concurrent sessions.
Credit expiry is not specified in the readable pricing page; check the current onboarding terms.

offer.summary: $30 one-time credits
conditions: Launch includes $30 once, with no credit card needed; the $0 monthly platform price does not make the credits renewable.
Browser time, proxy bandwidth, CAPTCHA solves and scraping tools are metered separately. Launch allows 10 concurrent sessions of up to 15 minutes; trial credit expiry is not published on this page.

offer.summary: $5 credits per month
conditions: Free credits renew monthly and unused subscription credit does not roll over. Additional usage requires available credit; paid plans can enable automatic top-ups.
Storage/ingestion, search and other operations have separate meters. Standard PDF extraction is available on Free; advanced PDF extraction requires Scale or Enterprise.
A separate three-month Scale offer for qualifying startups and academic research teams requires an application; it is not included for every Free account.

offer.summary: 1,000 API credits per month
conditions: No card required. Credits reset on the first day of each calendar month; requests stop after exhaustion until reset or upgrade.
Search, extract, crawl and research have different credit costs. The separate 100,000-credit startup program requires eligibility and is not the standard monthly allowance.

providers.name: Tigris
providers.description: Globally distributed S3-compatible object storage with separate storage and API-operation meters.

offer.summary: Monthly: 5 GB of Standard storage, 10,000 Class A and 100,000 Class B requests
conditions: No payment card required to start. The allowance refreshes monthly; storage is billed from average daily peak usage in GB-months, rather than an additional 5 GB retained forever each month.
Free storage applies to Standard. Class A includes PUT/COPY/POST/LIST and Class B includes GET and related reads. DELETE/CANCEL and regional/internet egress are free.
Infrequent Access and archive tiers have separate retrieval or minimum-retention charges. Free egress does not make storage, notifications or excess API operations unlimited.

sources.purpose: monthly free allowance, card requirement, S3 API operations and storage accounting

providers.name: Turso
providers.description: Hosted SQL databases with SQLite-compatible clients, embedded replicas and a management API.

offer.summary: 500M rows read and 10M rows written per month; 5 GB storage and 100 databases
conditions: Free requires no credit card. The plan also lists 3 GB monthly syncs; storage and database count are fixed capacity limits, not monthly refills.
Reads, writes and replica syncs are different metered resources. Paid overage prices and higher-tier retention or team features must not be assumed to apply to Free.

providers.name: Twilio
providers.description: Communications APIs for messages, phone calls, email, verification and phone-number lookups.

offer.summary: 30-day trial: 100 SMS, 100 WhatsApp messages, 75 voice minutes and 3,000 emails
conditions: No payment card required; email and personal phone verification are required. Trial resources expire 30 days after signup and are available only in supported countries.

Calls and messages are limited to verified recipients (up to 5) in the signup country; email is limited to the signup address. Predefined message/email templates apply; custom Voice TwiML has restrictions.
The trial also includes 40 verifications and 100 lookups. Cross-channel operations can deduct from multiple product counters; voice extras use the included voice-minute allowance.
These are starting units, not monthly free allocations. Separate post-upgrade free units require an account upgrade; subsequent usage is billed at product rates.

sources.purpose: API trial units, 30-day expiry, country and recipient restrictions

offer.summary: 10,000 free starting pages
conditions: No card required; usage-based billing after initial allowance.

providers.name: Upstash Redis
providers.description: Serverless Redis with an HTTP API for caching, queues and agent state.

offer.summary: 250 MB database storage, 500,000 commands and 10 GB bandwidth per month
conditions: Free account plan includes one database; adding a payment card to upgrade switches it to pay-as-you-go.
The separate accountless starter database expires after 3 days unless claimed. Once claimed it follows the account plan; no permanent accountless storage is promised.
Redis commands are the metered unit; a request containing multiple commands can consume more than one command.

offer.summary: $10 signup credit, or $20 with a work email
conditions: No payment card required. The starting balance is not a recurring monthly grant; expiry is not stated in the reviewed pricing and MCP pages.
All data sources are available while free credits last. Pay-as-you-go access afterward is limited to Web, arXiv and PubMed unless the account selects a qualifying paid plan.

offer.summary: 200 million free tokens for selected current models; other models differ
conditions: Initial free balances are per account and model-specific, not monthly. The current tables offer 200M tokens on selected embedding/reranking models; others have 50M or no free allowance.
Selected multimodal models separately list 200M text tokens and 150B pixels. Batch API tokens do not draw from free balances and are billed separately.
Card requirements and initial free-balance expiry are not stated. Model lists in the introductory text and detailed tables differ, so confirm the selected model against its current pricing row.

offer.summary: Always-free cluster: 100,000 objects, 1 GB memory and 10 GB disk; separate embedding and Query Agent quotas
conditions: No payment card required; one shared cluster per user, one collection and up to 3 tenants. These are capacity limits, not monthly replenishing objects.
Free includes 2,000 embedding requests per day and 1,000 Query Agent requests per month. These service quotas are separate from database capacity.
The Free comparison has no backup retention or high-availability replication; do not treat a free cluster as a production durability guarantee.

offer.summary: 100 keyless MCP search queries per day; separate $100 signup credit
conditions: The daily allowance applies to the MCP free profile, which exposes search and tool discovery without an account, API key or credit card. It does not include the Contents, Research or Finance tools.
New API accounts separately receive $100 starting credit with no card required. This is not a daily or monthly renewable credit balance; its expiry is not stated in the reviewed sources.
Authenticated API and MCP requests use account credits. The free MCP allowance must not be applied to every REST API endpoint.

sources.purpose: free daily MCP access and signup-credit eligibility
MCP free profile, tools and setup

offer.summary: 5,000 credits per month on Free
conditions: The current pricing page lists no payment card requirement, 5 concurrent requests, monthly refresh and no rollover. Free has no top-ups; wait for the next refresh or upgrade after exhaustion.

Credits are shared across web operations. A standard page starts at 1 credit; JavaScript rendering, premium proxies and browser sessions cost more. Standalone Residential Proxies are excluded from Free.

Only successful results consume credits, but returned 404 and 410 responses count as successful. The older MCP article still describes a 1,000-basic/40-protected-URL trial; use the current pricing plan instead.

sources.purpose: current monthly Free allowance, exclusions and reset rules

offer.summary: 10,000 credits per month
conditions: Free credits do not roll over and have no automatic top-up; includes 2 projects, 1 Context MCP Server seat and 5 custom entity/edge types.
Ingestion consumes 1 credit per 350 bytes or part thereof; retrieval and storage are not charged credits. Rate limits vary with service load, and Free episodes have lower processing priority.

Context MCP setup requires a project connection and user sign-in through the configured identity provider. Custom OIDC requires Enterprise; this is distinct from the public documentation MCP. Payment-card requirements are not stated on the reviewed pricing page.

sources.purpose: official MCP setup and access requirements

offer.summary: $5 initial credit, for first billing month
conditions: The $5 starting balance is shared across standard plans and expires at the end of the first billing month. It is not a recurring monthly grant.
After the first month the account is suspended until a spending limit is set. Switching between standard plans does not issue another starting credit; enterprise trials have separate terms.
